summary.aggregation: Unweighted geometric mean of each kernel median CPU ratio; startup is included in every timed process, not a separate aggregate workload.

storage.heap_scope: Engine construction and execution, excluding host input and all native stack frames. Both paths still construct the original Engine with a preallocated source vector; producer leaves that vector unused. Optimized path adds one fixed consumer-vector allocation, original experiment added two.

native_size.scope: Producer CLI supports a smaller primitive subset than ordinary CLI. Using group operations directly removes its last call into the full executor, allowing unrelated MVP paths to be dropped; size is not a full-functionality comparison.
